svg.text: Option B, the Bagan traveller: colourways
Plant and insect dyes long used in the region: indigo, turmeric, cutch, lac, and undyed cotton. Each is also shown at in-game size on the night colours.
turmeric yellow top, deep indigo check
white top, green check (indigo over yellow)
indigo top, red-brown check, yellow sash
pale grey top, charcoal check, lac crimson
pale indigo top, plum check, cream sash
